handbook-intro-text: Tobacco has survived the end of the world. So, statistically, will you, for a while. This guide covers everything from seed to butt. The short version 1. Plant tobacco seeds on farmland and harvest the leaves. 2. Dry the leaves, ideally on a drying rack. 3. Shred dried leaves with a knife, or by the stack on a tobacco cutter. 4. Roll the shredded tobacco into cigarettes with rolling paper. 5. Hold a light in your offhand and right click to smoke. Mind the cough. Chapters Growing tobacco and herbs Drying and shredding Rolling your own How to smoke (and what it does to you) Pipes and cigars Butts, ashtrays and flicking Factory brands and packs Pack dyes Vaping The Smoker's Ledger The Seraph General reminds you that smoking kills. Seraphs respawn, but the Seraph General would like you to stop testing this.
handbook-tobacco-text: Tobacco grows like any other crop: plant the seeds on farmland, keep it fed and warm, and harvest when it's fully grown. Harvesting gives fresh leaves and, if the soil gods are kind, seeds back. Finding seeds Your first seeds come from the wild. Tobacco, mint and clove grow in small clumps on fertile ground, each in its own climate: Burley and mint in cool to mild country, Virginia in temperate grassland, Oriental where it's hot and dry, and cloves only where it's hot and humid. Break a wild plant for its seeds and a few leaves. The agriculture trader also sells all five kinds of seed, when they're in stock. Varieties Virginia: feeds on potassium (K), ripens in about 1.6 months, frosts below 2 °C and wilts above 36 °C. The bright all-rounder that goes into most blends. Burley: feeds on nitrogen (N), about 1.8 months, hardy down to -1 °C, wilts above 32 °C. Good for colder climates and strong in a pipe. Oriental: feeds on phosphorus (P), the fastest at about 1.4 months, but wants it warm: frost below 5 °C, heat up to 42 °C. Small, aromatic leaves. Herbs Two more plants share the same crop rules and exist purely to make your habit taste better. Mint: nitrogen, 1 month, tough down to -3 °C. Dry it and crush it with a knife into menthol crystals for menthols. Refreshing, in the way a cold morning in a graveyard is refreshing. Clove shrub: phosphorus, 2 months, needs real heat (frost below 8 °C, fine up to 44 °C). The dried cloves go whole into kreteks, which crackle as you smoke them, like your lungs. Tips Rotate tobacco with crops that use a different nutrient, since each variety only drains its own. Oriental and cloves are a hot-climate crop; if you live somewhere cold, Burley and mint are your friends, and a trader can sell you seeds for whatever won't grow wild near you. Next: Drying and shredding
handbook-curing-text: Fresh leaves are green, wet and useless. Smoking them is technically possible in the sense that eating gravel is technically possible. Drying Fresh tobacco leaves dry on their own in your inventory or a container in about 96 hours. Herbs take 48. That is a long time to wait for a cigarette, which is why people built racks. Drying rack (6 sticks and rope): hangs 4 leaves and dries them 6 times faster. Drying frame (6 sticks and 3 rope): hangs 12 leaves on three bars, also 6 times faster. Barn-sized ambitions. Shredding Put a dried leaf in the crafting grid with a knife to get 2 shredded tobacco. Dried mint crushes the same way into menthol crystals. For anything bigger than a weekend habit, build a tobacco cutter (knife, iron ingot and 2 planks). It takes up to 32 dried leaves of one variety per load and turns each into 2 shredded with one 3-second crank. How batch furniture works The cutter, the rolling table and the racks all work the same way: Right click while holding ingredients to load them. Hold right click with an empty hand to work the whole batch. The results go straight into your inventory. Sneak and right click with an empty hand to take the ingredients back out. Running batches counts toward the Small Business, Assembly Line and Industrial Revolution achievements. The last one makes you an Industrialist, a title historically associated with lung disease. Next: Rolling your own
handbook-rolling-text: Rolling paper Cut parchment with a knife to get 8 rolling papers. You will need a lot of these. Filters, for the cautious, come from flax fibers (4 per craft). By hand Any shredded tobacco and a rolling paper make 3 hand-rolled cigarettes. Add menthol crystals for menthols, or dried cloves for kreteks. On a rolling table The rolling table (3 planks and a rolling paper) gets 10 cigarettes out of every paper instead of 3. Load shredded tobacco and papers, plus menthol crystals or dried cloves if you want flavour, then hold right click with an empty hand. One 2.5-second roll handles up to 8 pairs at once. Plain makes hand-rolled, menthol makes menthols, cloves make kreteks. What you can make Hand-rolled cigarette: 6 puffs, strength 1.0. The honest working cigarette. Hand-rolled menthol: 6 puffs, strength 0.9, and a small healing bonus. Doctors hate it, for many reasons. Hand-rolled kretek: 10 puffs, strength 1.3, crackles and spits embers. Cigar: 3 dried leaves, no paper. 20 puffs, strength 1.5, and a small healing bonus. Fancy cancer. Stub cigar: 1 dried leaf and 1 shredded make 2. 8 puffs, strength 1.3. Snipe: 6 cigarette butts and a rolling paper. 4 puffs, strength 0.8. The circle of life. See Butts. Next: How to smoke
handbook-smoking-text: Lighting up Hold the cigarette in your main hand and something burning in your offhand: a torch, a lantern, any glowing item, another lit cigarette, matches or a Zappo lighter. The first right click lights it and it shows "(lit)" in its name. From then on it stays lit, so you can put the light away. Matches are 4 sticks and resin for 24 lights. The Zappo is a brass ingot and flint for 300. Each light uses one. Lighting one cigarette from a stack splits it off, so you don't set the whole stack on fire, however tempting. Puffing Hold right click to take a drag: about 1.6 seconds for a cigarette, 2 for a pipe, 2.2 for a cigar. You exhale a cloud afterwards. When the last puff is gone you're left holding a butt. What it does Every puff gives you a 10-minute buff, scaled by how strong the smoke is: Hunger rate -25%. Who needs breakfast? Mining speed +5%. Nervous energy. Cigars and menthols also heal a little faster. Don't ask how. Nicotine and withdrawal Every puff also adds its strength to your nicotine level, which drains by 0.5 a minute. Let the buff run out while you're above 30 and withdrawal sets in: hunger +15%, mining speed -5%, and a steady stream of thoughts like "You'd trade a temporal gear for one drag right now." One puff fixes it. That's how they get you. Above 50 nicotine you'll also cough now and then, out loud, in chat, for everyone to enjoy. Next: Pipes and cigars
handbook-pipes-text: Pipes Carve a wooden pipe from firewood or a bone pipe from a bone, with a knife. Carved from bone. Fitting, really. To pack it, hold shredded tobacco in your offhand and right click. A bowl gives 15 puffs. Light it like a cigarette. The variety decides the strength: Burley 1.2, Virginia 1.0, Oriental 0.9. A pipe leaves no butt and is reused forever, which makes it the most sustainable way to ruin your health. Cigars A cigar is 3 dried leaves rolled together, shapeless, no paper. 20 slow puffs at strength 1.5 and a little extra healing. A stub cigar is the short version for people with somewhere to be. Both leave a cigar butt, which piles separately from cigarette butts because it has standards. Next: Butts, ashtrays and flicking
handbook-butts-text: Every cigarette ends as a butt. What you do next says a lot about you. The ashtray Five stones in a U make an ashtray. Right click it with a butt to stub it out, or with an empty hand to take one back. It holds 12 and looks emptier or fuller to match. Break it and the butts go everywhere, as nature intended. Flicking Right click while holding a butt to flick it. Where it lands it becomes a butt pile, holding up to 64 butts per block and visibly growing as more land on it. Pick them back up like any ground storage, one at a time or 8 at once. Butts that land in water just float there as items, judging you. Land one in an ashtray and something good happens. We won't spoil it. Sneak and right click to place butts by hand, if you're the tidy type. Flicking counts toward Litterbug and Serial Litterer. Recycling Butts are an ingredient, not just a mess: 6 cigarette butts and a rolling paper roll into a snipe. Every filtered factory brand takes 10 butts as the filter end of its pack recipe. Need more? A filter and a rolling paper make 4 clean butts. A filter and charcoal make 2 "pre-smoked" ones. A knife and a stub cigar make 2 cigar butts. Next: Factory brands and packs
handbook-brands-text: Why roll your own when you can pay for the privilege? Factory packs hold 20 cigarettes (with a few exceptions) of 8 puffs each, made to a fixed blend. Right click a pack to shake one out. The tooltip shows how many are left, the brand's slogan, and one of the Seraph General's Warnings. Collect them all. Making a pack Every pack recipe takes the brand's tobacco blend, rolling papers (usually 10), one to three buckets of dye in the brand's colours, and for filtered brands, 10 cigarette butts as the filter end. Yes, really. Check each pack's handbook page for its exact recipe. The brands Marlbury: 4 Virginia, 4 Burley. Filtered, strength 1.1. Red. Camul: 5 Oriental, 3 Virginia. Unfiltered, strength 1.0. Yellow and orange. Lucky Stroke: 8 Virginia, toasted over charcoal. Unfiltered, strength 1.2. Pall Moll: 3 of each variety. Unfiltered and long: 10 puffs. Winstun: 8 Burley. Filtered, strength 0.9. Newpart: 4 Virginia, 4 Burley, 2 menthol. Filtered, strength 0.9. Koal: 6 Burley, 3 menthol. Strength 1.0. Djarun Black: 4 Virginia, 2 Oriental, 3 cloves. A 12-pack of 12-puff kreteks at strength 1.4. Crackles. Dunhull International: 6 Virginia, 2 Oriental. Filtered, strength 1.0. Bensun & Hodges Gold: 5 Virginia, 3 Burley and a gold nugget. Filtered. Parlement: 4 Virginia, 4 Burley and a recessed filter. Strength 0.9. Gaulwaz Brunes: 6 Burley, 2 Oriental, charcoal. Unfiltered, strength 1.3. Kant: 4 Virginia, 4 Oriental. Filtered, strength 0.9. Vague Slims: 6 Virginia, 1 menthol. Slim, 6 puffs, strength 0.7. Sobrani Cocktail: 3 of each variety in pastel papers. Filtered. Belomorkanaal: 8 Burley. A 25-pack of 6-puff papirosy at strength 1.5. Mild Eleven: 6 Virginia, 2 Burley. Filtered, strength 0.8. Chesterfeld: 4 Virginia, 3 Burley, 1 Oriental. Filtered, strength 1.1. Rotmans: 10 rot. Strength 0.5 and it makes you hungrier. See below. The rotting pack Rotmans are made from rot, plus gray and green dye. The pack itself goes off: about 7 days fresh, then it decays into 5 rot over 3 more days. Each loose Rotmans cigarette spoils in about 2 days. Matured to perfection, then a bit further. Letting a pack rot away in your inventory is its own kind of achievement. Next: Pack dyes
handbook-paint-text: Brand packs need colour, and the colour comes from ordinary dye. Mix it in a barrel the usual way (see the game's own dyemaking guide), scoop it into a wooden bucket, and put the bucket in the pack recipe. Every pack uses 0.1 litres of each colour and hands the bucket back. Brand colours that need a stand-in Gold packs use yellow dye. Teal uses woad. Camul's brown is orange, and Rotmans' brown is gray, which suits it. Marketing has always been the most expensive part of a cigarette. Back to Factory brands and packs
handbook-vaping-text: For the modern seraph who wants to quit smoking and start something else. The Jool temporal vaporizer is made from a brass ingot, a rusty gear and glass. Brewing e-liquid E-liquid is a real liquid: it goes in buckets, jugs and barrels, and it is brewed in a sealed barrel. Plain: 1 litre of water and 4 shredded tobacco (any variety), sealed for 24 hours. Every flavour starts from plain. Menthol: 1 litre of plain and 2 menthol crystals, 12 hours. Clove: 1 litre of plain and 2 dried cloves, 12 hours. Fruit: 1 litre of plain and 4 of the fruit, 12 hours. Strawberry, Blueberry, Cherry, Mango, Peach, Apple, Pineapple, Lychee (any apple works). Cartridges Half a glass slab and a wooden bucket holding 0.8 litres of e-liquid make 4 cartridges of 20 puffs. Hold one in your offhand and right click with the vape, or drop it onto the vape in your inventory. Whatever was left in the tank goes with the old one. No cartridges? Sneak and right click a placed bucket, jug or barrel of e-liquid with the vape to fill the tank straight from it. The tank holds 20 puffs of one flavour at a time. Charging Drop a gear onto the vape in your inventory: a temporal gear fills it to 300 charges, a rusty gear adds 40. Every puff uses one charge. Strength Clove 1.2, plain 1.0, menthol, cherry and pineapple 0.9, most fruit 0.8, lychee 0.7. No light needed, the cloud you exhale is twice the size, and it leaves no butt, which is the only thing it has going for it environmentally. Burning a temporal gear to power a vape is, the Seraph General notes, a choice.
handbook-ledger-text: Somebody has to keep track of your decline. The Smoker's Ledger is the mod's own achievement system: it watches what you smoke, where, how often and how badly, and hands out recognition accordingly. Achievements Achievements are sorted into seven categories: Habit, Connoisseur, Hardware, Situational, Social, Body and Meta. Each is worth tar points by tier: Bronze Lung 5, Silver Lung 15, Gold Lung 40, Platinum Lung 100. Many only unlock after the ones before them, so they come in chains. Some ideas to get you started: Smoke in strange situations: at night, in the rain, in a temporal storm, underground, up a mountain, freezing, scorching, swimming, sprinting, riding, starving, on fire, at 2 HP, next to a trader or next to another smoker. Keep a daily streak going. Try every brand, open every pack and read every warning. Run batches on the furniture. Flick butts with intent. Some achievements are secret. They show "??? Nobody knows. Keep smoking." until you've earned their prerequisites, then give you a cryptic hint. Ranks Points earn ranks, and every promotion is announced to the whole server so your family can be notified. Curious Seraph (0), Social Smoker (25), Pack-a-Day (75), Chain Smoker (150, gift of rolling papers), Human Chimney (300), Lung Donor (500, a Golden Zappo lighter), Patient Zero (800), The Marlbury Man (1,100, a box of cigars). Traits Certain achievements leave a permanent mark on your character, good and bad. Smoker's Lungs, for example, makes you less hungry and a little slower. The tumour's name is Gerald. Earned traits appear on your character screen. Commands /smokestats shows your rank, points, progress to the next rank, streak and estimated life lost. /smokestats list [category] shows every achievement with its progress. /smokestats ranks lists the ranks and their rewards.
itemdesc-eliquidportion-strawberry: Sweet, pink and aggressively artificial for something made of real strawberries. Strength 0.8. Seal 1 litre of plain e-liquid with 4 strawberries in a barrel for 12 hours.
itemdesc-eliquidportion-blueberry: Tastes like a muffin that took up smoking. Strength 0.8. Seal 1 litre of plain e-liquid with 4 blueberries in a barrel for 12 hours.
itemdesc-eliquidportion-cherry: Dark, sweet and a little like cough syrup, which is fitting. Strength 0.9. Seal 1 litre of plain e-liquid with 4 cherries in a barrel for 12 hours.
itemdesc-eliquidportion-mango: Tropical, thick and smells like a holiday you will never take. Strength 0.8. Seal 1 litre of plain e-liquid with 4 mangoes in a barrel for 12 hours.
itemdesc-eliquidportion-peach: Soft and fuzzy on the way in, less so on the way out. Strength 0.8. Seal 1 litre of plain e-liquid with 4 peaches in a barrel for 12 hours.
itemdesc-eliquidportion-apple: Crisp green apple, any apple will do. An apple a day keeps nothing away. Strength 0.8. Seal 1 litre of plain e-liquid with 4 apples (any kind) in a barrel for 12 hours.
itemdesc-eliquidportion-pineapple: Sharp and sour, with a sting at the back of the throat. Strength 0.9. Seal 1 litre of plain e-liquid with 4 pineapples in a barrel for 12 hours.
itemdesc-eliquidportion-lychee: Floral and delicate, the mildest one on the shelf. Strength 0.7. Seal 1 litre of plain e-liquid with 4 lychees in a barrel for 12 hours.
